summary.whatChanges: Re-exports the internal `Unwrap` type from `@trpc/server` as `TRPCUnwrap`, so generated `.d.ts` files can reference it. Adds a test example with a generic authentication middleware factory plus a server-only tsconfig, and wires that extra type-check into the example's build script.
behaviorChanges: `@trpc/server` now publicly exposes a `TRPCUnwrap` type alias (marked @internal)
Declaration emit for code using generic procedure/middleware factories can now name the previously unexported `Unwrap` type instead of failing
The internal-types-export example build additionally runs `tsc -p tsconfig.server-only.json`, emitting to build/server-only
risks: Exporting an internal type widens the public API surface; consumers may depend on `TRPCUnwrap` even though it is annotated @internal and could change
The new example creates a tRPC instance inside a factory function, which may be an unusual pattern to hold up as a supported example
